import json

with open("mcp-agent-ml-research-read_registry-1778875426587.txt", "r") as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

# The result field is a JSON string
data = json.loads(raw["result"])
experiments = data["data"]["experiments"]

# Target experiment IDs
targets = [
    "eval-acr-object-v4-obs-only",
    "eval-vla-only-object",
    "eval-vla-mean-object",
    "eval-acr-object-v4-perdof",
    "eval-acr-object-v4-scalar",
    "eval-acr-object-obs-only-norm02",
]

# Also search for anything with "argmin" and "object"
argmin_matches = [k for k in experiments if "argmin" in k.lower() and "object" in k.lower()]
print("=== Argmin+Object matches ===")
for m in argmin_matches:
    print(f"  {m}")
print()

# Collect all target keys
all_targets = list(targets) + argmin_matches

# Also check for close matches for any target not found
found_keys = set()
for t in all_targets:
    if t in experiments:
        found_keys.add(t)
    else:
        # fuzzy search
        candidates = [k for k in experiments if t in k]
        if candidates:
            for c in candidates:
                found_keys.add(c)
        else:
            print(f"NOT FOUND: {t}")

# Now print all found experiments in detail
for exp_id in sorted(found_keys):
    exp = experiments[exp_id]
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"EXP_ID: {exp_id}")
    print(json.dumps(exp, indent=2))
